SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Well now... What should I do?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm not obliged to listen to anything you say.
[FI] From the looks of things, should I give it another try?
[FI] What should I say anyway...? Or should I just monitor the situation quietly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...At a loss for words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] After coming all this way, you've run out of words to say? You're so useless...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] N-No, it's nothing like that....!
[FI] Damn... Staying quiet had the opposite effect...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I know I'm being long-winded, but please.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] "I'm hiding something" is written all over your face. Doesn't it just feel weird when you don't want me to be concerned over this?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ......Oh well, it could probably be because of me that you're doing so much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So you want to hear it, no matter what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No matter what.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So... I am considered one of your 【important friends】?
[FI] Guh... So embarrassing to hear her repeat it like that...
[FI] Well, now that I came so far, it'd be wrong to try and dodge the subject...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah... You might say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh, is that so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's fine then, I'll give you a reward. Since you answered so honestly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why are you looking down on me? Wait, a reward...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I shall answer you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're such a hopeless person, aren't you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] *sigh* How pathetic... Fine then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There's no way around it, so listen well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] R-Really...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...I guess you have heard from Saori? About my circle taking part in the upcoming Summer Comiket.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, I've heard about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That piece of manuscript hasn't been proceeding as smoothly as planned.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So now I'm falling behind and trying to turn it around... That's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...That's all?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes. That's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...You sure are persistent.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm... Then leave this to me! I will--

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't need it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I haven't even said anything yet!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You would say "Allow me to help out!" anyway, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Can you read my mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do you know what an "unwelcome favor" means? That's what you are right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Can you please not misunderstand? I'm only telling you this because you're being persistent and I don't have the slightest intention of letting you take part.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...So please don't do any more unnecessary things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Unnecessary things...? I just want to help you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Haven't I said it before? It's better to keep away from hindrances. These are all obstacles when it comes to production of works.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Am I really being a hindrance?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right. It is troublesome if I were to allow an amateur to take part.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do you understand now? Can you even draw manga?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...It's true that I can't, but I also know this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] An "assistant" is required when it comes to manga, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Furthermore, there are many other things to do... That even an amateur could help out with.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh, this is a surprise... Senpai actually knows about these things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Because I have known you long enough, that's why I know just this much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph, all right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This is all just a façade anyway.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A façade?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I shall inform you of the truth.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It will surely hurt you... But you would still want to hear it anyway, right? Therefore...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Are you prepared?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, any time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, you have some nerve... Well then, allow me to tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] To me, creating is the act of taking a fragment of my mind and recreate it, sublime it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It is no exaggeration when I say that I created something new.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Which is why I shall not allow anyone to trespass on this domain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Especially someone like you, who doesn't even know where he stands. Never.
[FI] Although her method of putting this across is unique, in short, isn't it still about that?
[FI] "Don't come close to me". Isn't that what you're trying to say, Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I should have said it before, if one were to step into the domain, punishment will be met.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Your punishment is my rejection. Are you able to withstand this punishment?
[FI] ...Ah, I can't stand it... I can't bear it at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...I'm sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph... I'm glad that you understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Damn it... I sure am useless.
[FI] ...I didn't expect to be rejected so straightforwardly.
[FI] Just when I thought Kuroneko would listen to me if I pushed on strongly...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] And I thought our relationship would be fixed...
